title: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Ubud Bali
metaTitle: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali
metaDescription: Advance your yoga journey in Bali with our 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali, Yoga Alliance RYS 300. Deepen asana, pranayama, philosophy & teaching skills in 25 transformative days.
summary: This advanced course is a continuation of all that you learned in your 200-hour yoga training course.
intro: 300 hours advanced hatha / ashtanga / Vinyasa flow based yoga teacher training at Bali Yoga School will help you in building an elegant structure. It will help you to gain a better understanding of yoga which in turn comes in handy when you become an advanced yoga teacher. The 300 Hour yoga teacher training in Bali has been designed with sophistication and utmost care, according to the standards set by Yoga Alliance, for those who have completed a 200 Hour teacher training course.

During the 300 Hour program, we emphasize yoga teaching and sequencing of advanced yoga practices. Our yoga teachers impart teaching and training of several yoga aspects from Asanas / pranayama / meditation / Yoga philosophy / yoga Anatomy / Yoga therapy to teaching practicum and methodology.

After completing 300 Hour yoga teacher training, you will be able to teach beginner, intermediate and advanced level yoga students with confidence. We train yoga teachers to become independent, wise and flexible and you will be prepared to deal with the most challenging class, special needs and health issues of the clients.
This advanced course is a continuation of all that you learned in your 200-hour yoga training course. You will acquire the skills of dealing with complicated circumstances with grace and confidence.

curriculum.title: Hatha Yoga
items: Surya Namaskar (Pranamasana, Hasta Uttanasana, Padahastasana, Ashwa Sanchalanasana, Dandasana, Ashtanga Namaskar, Bhujangasana)

curriculum.title: Ashtanga Vinyasa Flow
items: 1st week – Recap of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Half Primary Series / Memorizing and understanding the sequence to prepare for Mysore practice

2nd & 3rd week – Mysore-style practice of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Full Primary Series to help each of you develop at your own pace / Led Class of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Full Primary Series / Teaching practice

curriculum.title: Dhyan (Meditation)
items: Om Mani Padme Hum Buddha Mantra Meditation
Manipura Chakra (Solar Plexus Chakra) Mantra Meditation
Ajna Chakra (Third Eye Chakra) Mantra Meditation
Yoga Nidra Meditation with Sound Healing Bowls

curriculum.title: Yoga Therapy & Ayurveda – Yoga Therapy
items: Yoga Therapy for Musculoskeletal Issues (Arthritis / Osteoporosis / Backpain)
Yoga Therapy for Digestive Issues (Constipation / Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS))
Yoga Therapy for Respiratory Issues (Asthma / Sinusitis)
Yoga Therapy for Nervous System Issues (Anxiety / Migraine / Depression)

curriculum.title: Yoga Therapy & Ayurveda – Ayurveda
items: Basic Concepts of Ayurveda: Dosha, Dhatus, Mala, Agni, and Ama

curriculum.title: Pranayama (Breathing Practices)
items: Nadi Shodhana Pranayama / Anulom Vilom Pranayama
Surya Bhedana Pranayama / Chandra Bhedi Pranayama

curriculum.title: Yoga Philosophy
items: Shad Darshan (Classification of Indian Philosophy, Aastika & Naastika Darshan)
Introduction of Patanjali Yoga Sutras / 4 Chapter of PYS

curriculum.title: Yoga Anatomy & Physiology
items: Brief Introduction of Skeleton System & Function
Anatomy of Shoulder & Function with Important Name of Muscles
Anatomy of Pelvic Girdle with Names of Muscles
Spine Anatomy & Function / Importance in Yoga Practice
Chakra Introduction & Function with the Endocrine System
Nadis – the Energy Channel Function & Importance
Prana Introduction & Importance in Organ Function
Panchakosha Importance in Function of the Body

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 27th of every month at 5:00 pm. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
prerequisites: The 300 Hour yoga teacher training in Bali is designed for those who have completed 200 Hour teacher training course.

All students joining our 300-hour Yoga Teacher Training are required to complete the prerequisite assignment before arrival and submit it during check-in. Please print the assignment and compile it into a file for submission.
A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. The practice and especially the teaching of yoga demand a high degree of self-discipline and purity.
To ensure the success of the program, participants are required to attend all spiritual activities, meditation sessions, lectures and asana classes.

Meat, fish, eggs, black tea, coffee, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the yoga practice. Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Prerequisite Assignment
items: Upon confirmation of your 300-hour YTT booking, we will provide the assignment questions along with our 200-hour YTT course manual.
Each topic must be answered in 300–500 words.
The 200-Hour YTT Manual (PDF) has been shared with you for reference and guidance while completing the assignment.
If you are unable to complete the assignment due to limited time before the course starts, you may submit it within the first 7 days of the training.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: All classes are mandatory; only in case of an emergency or illness can one take leave with the respective teacher’s permission. Uninformed leaves won’t be accepted and this will leave a bad impression on the student’s performance.

policies.title: Discipline Rules for Students
items: Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited in the school.
If you are fasting on any day, you have to inform the kitchen manager to avoid food waste.
Always maintain discipline, respect teachers and follow all rules. Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Before departure return your books, maps or any goods which you borrowed.
Friends or relatives will not be included in accommodation; however, they can stay in school by renting another room.
